lines.speaker: CASS
lines.text: At 3-0 down – well I'd had enough!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Walking to his barn, he heard something from the valley below.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He raced down on his quad bike and found Sallie, stuck in a ditch, mud up to her chest. She'd been there for hours.

lines.speaker: CASS
lines.text: I just couldn't believe what I was seeing!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He tried rope and boards, but the mud wouldn't let go. No signal. So he raced home to call for help.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Firefighters, police, a boat team, four ambulance crews, helicopters. Two hours later, Sallie was free.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Later, she sent him a card.

lines.speaker: SALLIE
lines.text: Thanks to Arsenal for being rubbish at football!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: All because his team was losing…
